# Handmade fixture instructions

This bundle was authored by hand, not by `agent-compose compose`. It exists to
hold the producer contract honest: every path, field, and cross-reference here
was written from `docs/bundle-protocol.md` and `internal/bundle/verify.go`
rather than captured from a composition run.

Nothing in this tree describes a real seat. `fixture:handmade` is not a source
anybody resolves, and `courier` is not a role in the roster.
